issue.title: Problem with quarkus live reload with a jaxb project
issue.body:
Hi

Like I said here https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/quarkus-dev/wAvgJ6wiExU, I have a problem with jaxB project.

The first problem is with the live reload mode, and I have describe the problem here : https://github.com/tcollignon/quarkus-jaxb-test
If you need some more information I can share it. I have debug it, and I think it's a classloader issue because QName is never valid in Live reload mode.

I have notice that I have the same problem with graalvm into docker container, I've got the same error

Totally forgot about it, sorry. Let's try to get this done for 0.20.0.
Adding `good first issue` here as I think it shouldn't be too hard to fix given the information present in the GraalVM issue.
Nice, tell me if I can help you !

issue.title: Fix JAXB usage in native executables
issue.body:
Fixes #2305

The test case is heavily based on the test case provided by @tcollignon here: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/2305 .
